scope: Actual exponential mixture/clock cutoff/Gaussian-only target concentration and actual full rectangle supremum
status_policy: Supporting passage inference and statement acceptance are separate. Exact kernel types and routes are fresh hashed working-checkout exports, not a clean whole-paper replay. Lower author-owned source rows await separate independent review. Historical ledgers are preserved.

passages.title: Gaussian endpoint smoothing
passages.claim: The actual full rectangle distance of an arbitrary measurable observation is bounded by its actual smooth supremum plus h*gSigma*L, for singular Gaussian targets with unit marginals.

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lemma_E3_intrinsic_smoothing
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p : ℕ},
  1 ≤ p →
    ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
      Measurable V →
        ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ),
          (∀ (j : Fin p), (A * A.transpose) j j = 1) →
            ∀ (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h),
              RectangleCLT.Companion.rectangleDistance μ V A ≤
                RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicGaussianSmoothingConstant *
                  (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.smoothingDiscrepancy μ V A h hh +
                    h * RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianMaximumMean A * RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p)

passages.title: Actual signed mixture discrepancy
passages.claim: Exact exponential-clock mixture and integrability give the signed smooth difference as the expectation of the actual random-box discrepancy.

passages.title: Good clock event
passages.claim: The actual good-clock event has complement probability at most1/4 and controls every threshold shift by d=O(hL).

passages.route_variation: The proof uses direct exponential-clock tail/union estimates rather than applying Markov to the already separately checked clock mean.

passages.title: Outward comparison
passages.claim: On the good event, actual expanded random boxes contain the original box and lie within its2d enlargement; Gaussian concentration alone controls the added target mass.

full_type_evidence.name: _private.RectangleCLTArxivV1.PairedGaussianEndpointSmoothing.0.RectangleCLTArxivV1.random_shifted_sandwich
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {p : ℕ} (lo hi : RectangleCLT.Vector p) (t h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (d : ℝ) (e : ℝ × (RectangleCLT.Face p → ℝ)),
  (∀ (f : RectangleCLT.Face p), |h * Real.log (e.2 f / e.1)| ≤ d) →
    (RectangleCLT.Companion.shiftedBox lo hi (t - d)).carrier ⊆
        {x | ((RectangleCLTArxivV1.shiftedSmoother✝ lo hi t h hh).randomRectangle e).Inside x} ∧
      {x | ((RectangleCLTArxivV1.shiftedSmoother✝ lo hi t h hh).randomRectangle e).Inside x} ⊆
        (RectangleCLT.Companion.shiftedBox lo hi (t + d)).carrier

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussian_probability_shiftedBox_intrinsic
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {p : ℕ},
  1 ≤ p →
    ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ),
      (∀ (j : Fin p), (A * A.transpose) j j = 1) →
        ∀ (lo hi : RectangleCLT.Vector p) {r : ℝ},
          0 < r →
            (RectangleCLT.gaussianLaw A).real (RectangleCLT.Companion.shiftedBox lo hi r).carrier ≤
              (RectangleCLT.gaussianLaw A).real (RectangleCLT.Rect.closedBox lo hi).carrier +
                2 * r * RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianMaximumMean A

full_type_evidence.name: _private.RectangleCLTArxivV1.PairedGaussianEndpointSmoothing.0.RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussian_endpoint_cutoff_smoothing
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {p : ℕ},
  1 ≤ p →
    ∀ (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure (RectangleCLT.Vector p)) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
      (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ),
      (∀ (j : Fin p), (A * A.transpose) j j = 1) →
        ∀ (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (d : ℝ),
          0 < d →
            ∀ (good : Set (ℝ × (RectangleCLT.Face p → ℝ))),
              MeasurableSet good →
                (∀ e ∈ good, ∀ (f : RectangleCLT.Face p), |h * Real.log (e.2 f / e.1)| ≤ d) →
                  (RectangleCLT.exponentialRectangleLaw p).real goodᶜ ≤ 1 / 4 →
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.rectangleDistance ν id A ≤
                      2 * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.smoothingDiscrepancy ν id A h hh +
                        4 * 2 * d * RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianMaximumMean A

passages.title: Integrate and absorb global distance
passages.claim: A proved good-event integration inequality charges the complement by twice the global rectangle distance. Apply both signs to every finite box, extend to all rectangles, then absorb rho/2.

full_type_evidence.name: _private.RectangleCLTArxivV1.PairedGaussianEndpointSmoothing.0.RectangleCLTArxivV1.integrate_good_event_bound
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace E] (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure E)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (good : Set E),
  MeasurableSet good →
    ∀ (f : E → ℝ),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable f ν →
        ∀ (a rho err : ℝ),
          |a| ≤ rho →
            (∀ (e : E), |f e| ≤ rho) →
              0 ≤ err → (∀ e ∈ good, a ≤ f e + err) → a ≤ ∫ (e : E), f e ∂ν + err + 2 * rho * ν.real goodᶜ
